text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Sorry to have kept you waiting! I know I'm late! I was going "take this!" and helping people in trouble, and then...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お待たせ～！
約束に遅れてごめんねっ！
困ってる人を
え～い
って助けたりしてて……！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Even though you went out of your way to say you wanted to see me on my birthday~! But really, really... I was looking forward to it so much... munya...
text_block_list.orig_text:
せっかくキミが誕生日に会いたい
って言ってくれたのに～！
でもでも、
すっごく楽しみにしてたんだ……
むにゃ……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Zzz... Hmm...?! Aaah! I fell asleep! And on my birthday with you, of all times~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
スヤスヤ……
うぅん……？
っ、
ああー！　
寝ちゃってた！
せっかくの、
キミと一緒の誕生日なのに～！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Sorry... you stayed by my side the whole time? Ehehe... didn't you give me a lap pillow like this before, too? I'm hopeless, huh... always causing you trouble.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ごめんね。
ずっとそばにいてくれたんだ？
えへへ……
前も、
膝枕してもらったっけ。
ダメだなぁ、
キミに迷惑かけてばかり。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: WHA...! Geez, you can be so unfair! I wanna see your sleeping face too! If that's how it is, I'm gonna demand it as my birthday present!
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ、
も～！　
ずるいよ～！
私だってキミの寝顔が見たい！
こうなったら、
誕生日プレゼントとして要求しちゃうよ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Come on, sleep right here and now! As for the pillow... I've got two certain somethings that are super fluffy and guaranteed to give you the best sleep ever☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら、
寝て寝て！
枕は……
安眠間違いなしの
ふよふよなのがあるからっ☆

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Hehe, what do you think? Is this Hatsune-chan's pillow to your liking? You're getting sleepy in no time, aren't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
どうかな？
初音ちゃん枕は？　
あっという間に眠くなってきたでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Thank you☆ Waaah, you've got such a nice sleeping face~ I'm always the one being watched while I sleep, so this feels kinda new♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとねっ☆
うわぁ、
とってもいい顔だ～
いつも寝てるところを見られてばかりだから、
新鮮な気分♪

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: When you wake up, let's keep celebrating my birthday together. We'll eat cake, look up at the night sky, and if it gets cold, we'll hold hands~♪ ...Maybe I'll even have us fly through the sky using my ESPer powers.
text_block_list.orig_text:
起きたら一緒に、
誕生日の続きをしようね。
ケーキを食べて、
夜空を眺めて、
寒くなったら手を繋いで～♪
……超能力で
空なんて飛んじゃったりして。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Just kidding~ Ehehe... let's make it a really fun birthday, okay...☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
な～んて、
ね。
えへへ、
楽しい誕生日にしようね……☆
